label: A proposition holds exactly when it is proved at some stage
paraphrase: Open premise of the comparison, not attributed to the witness: a proposition holds exactly when it is proved at some stage. It strengthens the entry's primacy of proof (STMT-PROOF-NOT-TRUTH-CENTRAL-INTUITIONISM, about mathematical statements) to a biconditional for every proposition, as the intuitionist's answer to Q-TRUTH.
